question: The South Indian film dance choreographer, K Shivashankar, won which of the following prestigious awards in 2010 for the best choreography in the Telugu film Magadheera?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Film Award.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****National Film Award**

__
 
• The most prominent** film award ceremony** in India.
 
• Established in **1954.**
 
• It has been administered by the** Indian government's Directorate of Film Festivals since 1973.**
 
• **Soorarai Pottru** won the **2020** National Film Award.

 **K Shivashankar**

 
• **​**Indian dance choreographers worked in** more than 10 languages **(majorly with South Indian films, including Tamil films & Telugu films).
 
• He won National Film Award for **Dheera Dheera Dheera** in **Magadheera.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Filmfare Award

 
• They are** annual awards that honour artistic and technical excellence in the Hindi-language film industry of India**.
 
• The Filmfare ceremony is** one of the most famous film events in India**. 
 
• **Sidharth Malhotra's Shershaah** dominated the awards this year.

**International Film Academy Award**

 
• It is one of the **Academy Awards handed out annually by the U.S.-based Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS)**.
 
• It is given to a **feature-length motion picture produced outside the United States with a predominantly non-English dialogue track.**
 
• **Drive My Car **won the 2021 award.

**Guild Award**

 
• They are accolades given by the** Screen Actors Guild-American Federation of Television and Radio Artists.**
 
• The award was **founded in 1952 **to recognize **outstanding performances in movies and prime-time television.**
 
• It presents** thirteen awards.**
 
• **Gosford Park** has the **largest winning cast.**
